title: VirtualMachineAssessPatchesResult
description: Describes the properties of an AssessPatches result.

status.description: The overall success or failure status of the operation.

assessmentActivityId.description: The activity ID of the operation.

rebootPending.description: The overall reboot status of the VM. It will be true when partially installed patches require a reboot to complete installation but the reboot has not yet occurred.

criticalAndSecurityPatchCount.description: The number of critical or security patches detected.

otherPatchCount.description: The number of all available patches excluding critical and security.

startDateTime.description: The UTC timestamp when the operation began.
